title: Kekkon: Marriage: Zen'ya
overview:
A big-service character disc released ahead of the new-sensation simulation "Kekkon - Marriage -"!!

Over 100 high-resolution graphics included!
A full lineup of popular voice actors!!
Self-introductions & a radio drama specially included!!
Plenty of other fun extras
Experience the "Kekkon World" ahead of time!!

高解像度グラフィックを100点以上収録!
人気声優が勢揃い!!
